Name: Character customization anywhere
Author: corjea
Description:
Press numpad 1 to bring up the character customization menu (allows you to change your appearance, your gender, your favorite thing and your pet's appearance)

UPDATE (1.0.1) : you can now change the key binding (see the included readme and this link for details https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings)

UPDATE (1.0.2) : you can change your pants and shirt.
If you want the last update, delete the old version of the mod and unzip the new version to your Stardew Valley mods folder.

Manifest.Name: CharacterCustomizationAnywhere
Manifest.Description: Customize the player anywhere in the game
Manifest.Author: jeanne
